name: read-imap-codex-plugin
description: Read-only IMAP helper for extracting registration links and codes from incoming email.

interface.shortDescription: Extract registration links and codes from an IMAP inbox.
interface.longDescription: Provides read-only IMAP tools for finding recent registration and verification emails, extracting likely confirmation links and one-time codes, and summarizing matching messages. It does not accept commands from email and does not modify messages.
defaultPrompt: Find the latest registration code in my IMAP inbox.
Look for a confirmation link from this website.
